# CVixeo

> CVixeo is an AI-powered CV and resume platform that helps job seekers create ATS-optimized resumes, analyze job descriptions, identify missing keywords, and tailor their CVs to specific job opportunities. It is a web application (no installation), available in English, French and Dutch, at https://www.cvixeo.com/.

## What is CVixeo?

An AI CV builder and ATS resume optimizer whose core feature is job description matching: it compares a CV with a specific job posting and shows which skills and keywords are missing. CVixeo is currently in beta.

## What does CVixeo do?

- AI CV builder: drafts a professional summary and achievement-focused bullet points from the information the user enters.
- ATS optimization: templates use standard section headings and real text; the ATS check (Premium) gives a 0–100 score with 3–5 suggestions.
- Job description matching (Premium): compares a CV with a pasted job description and returns a match score broken down by skills, experience, keywords, education and languages, plus matching/missing keywords and recommendations. The analysis can be re-run after editing.
- CV analysis and keyword analysis: points out weak spots and the job-posting keywords not found in the CV.
- CV improvement: imports an existing CV (PDF, DOCX or TXT) and rewrites the content with AI.
- Cover letter generator (Premium): writes a cover letter from the CV, the job description and the company name.
- 15 professional templates and PDF export (free-plan PDFs carry a watermark).

## Who is CVixeo for?

Job seekers applying online, students and graduates writing a first CV, career changers, multilingual candidates (notably in Belgium) applying in English, French or Dutch, and anyone updating an outdated CV.

## What makes CVixeo different?

- Built around the job description, not just text generation.
- Consistent, explainable scoring: fixed weights — skills 40%, experience 25%, keywords 20%, education 10%, languages 5%.
- No invented experience: recommendations are based only on detected matches and gaps in the user's own CV data.
- Cross-language matching across English, French and Dutch.
- Scores measure alignment with a job description; they are not a hiring probability and not a guarantee of passing an ATS.

## Pricing (EUR)

- Free: 1 CV, 2 templates, watermarked PDF export.
- 7-Day Premium Pass: €3.99 one-time.
- Premium: €12/month, or €9/month billed annually (€108/year). Includes job description matching, the ATS score, cover letters, all templates, unlimited CVs and watermark-free PDFs.

AI features are powered by Claude (Anthropic). Contact: support@cvixeo.com.
